description: Source code for the LP5562 LED driver, implementing control over a 4-channel I2C LED driver with programmable lighting patterns, brightness control, and engine management.

methods.name: lp5562_get_pwm_reg
methods.description: Get the PWM register address for a specific LED channel.

methods.name: lp5562_get_engine_ram_base_addr
methods.description: Get the base address of program memory for a specific engine.

methods.name: lp5562_get_engine_reg_shift
methods.description: Get the bit shift for engine register based on engine index.

methods.name: lp5562_ms_to_prescale_and_step
methods.description: Convert milliseconds to prescale and step_time for engine programming.

methods.name: lp5562_set_led_source
methods.description: Assign a source (PWM or engine) to a specific LED channel.

methods.name: lp5562_get_led_source
methods.description: Retrieve the current source assigned to a specific LED channel.

methods.name: lp5562_is_engine_executing
methods.description: Check if a specific engine is currently running.

methods.name: lp5562_get_available_engine
methods.description: Find an unused engine for programming.

methods.name: lp5562_set_engine_reg
methods.description: Set a register value for a specific engine.

methods.name: lp5562_set_engine_op_mode
methods.description: Set the operational mode (load, run, disable) for an engine.

methods.name: lp5562_set_engine_exec_state
methods.description: Set the execution state (hold, run) for an engine.

methods.name: lp5562_start_program_exec
methods.description: Start execution of a program on a specific engine.

methods.name: lp5562_stop_program_exec
methods.description: Stop execution of a program on a specific engine.

methods.name: lp5562_program_command
methods.description: Write a command to an engine's program memory.

methods.name: lp5562_program_set_brightness
methods.description: Program a command to set fixed brightness.

methods.name: lp5562_program_ramp
methods.description: Program a ramp (fade) command for brightness.

methods.name: lp5562_program_wait
methods.description: Program a wait (delay) command.

methods.name: lp5562_program_go_to_start
methods.description: Program a command to loop back to start.

methods.name: lp5562_update_blinking_brightness
methods.description: Change brightness during blinking pattern.

methods.name: lp5562_led_blink
methods.description: Configure a blinking pattern on an LED.

methods.name: lp5562_led_set_brightness
methods.description: Set brightness of a specific LED.

methods.name: lp5562_led_on
methods.description: Turn on an LED at maximum brightness.

methods.name: lp5562_led_off
methods.description: Turn off an LED.

methods.name: lp5562_led_init
methods.description: Initialize the LED driver hardware.
